system.description:
Lamp oil? Rope? Bombs? You want it? It's yours my friend, as long as you have enough rubies. —Morshu, Link: The Faces of Evil May they be an appraiser of rare magic items, peddler of illicit substances, or bookkeeper for the court, merchants are masters of exchange.

The merchant is a low-defense and damage character, who provides high-support through a wider inventory pool and optimizing your party's resources. In combat, you should look out for allies in need of assistance and strategize what items to use.

  • Action: Use
  • Move: Flexible (skip to Use)
  • Key Stat: Luck/Reason
  • Complexity: HHHII
  • Training: Craft, Finesse, Influence

Trainings at Level 1: the Class's Trainings, plus a number of additional Trainings equal to half your Reason (round up).

features.name: Deep Pockets
features.description: You gain the Deft Hands Perk (p. 68), and you gain 2 extra Item Slots now and every 3 Levels hereafter.

features.name: Gold Sink
features.description: You can take the Use Action to place Item(s) that aren't Fabled Relics inside a container and choose one Item with a value no higher than the Item(s) placed inside. The chosen Item replaces the originals. If the value exceeds 1g, you must spend 1 Luck to do so.

features.name: Line Goes Up
features.description:
You gain 1 Luck during a Breather and when you spend a Shift to Craft or Travel.

Further, when you Rest, you gain 1 extra Luck. This extra Luck gained from a Rest increases by 1 every 4 Levels hereafter.

Merchant: 2nd, 6th, 10th Level.

features.name: Diamond Hands
features.description:
You can take the Use Action to change the Power of a Relic you are holding to another Power of equal or lesser value. The Powers must be valued at 250g or lower. This value is multiplied by 5 every 4 Levels hereafter.

Merchant: 4th, 8th Level.

features.name: Opportunist
features.description: Once per Round after another Being uses an Action or Move, you can immediately take the Use Action.

features.name: Midas Touch
features.description: Any Relic Item Bonus or Rank is increased by 1 while you have it Equipped.
